# Typography > Heading and Text over the token-driven type scale: level is the document outline, size is the rung, tone is the color role, className stays layout-only. A bare text-* rung is for HTML React doesn't render as components, such as email HTML; MDX maps its tags to Heading and Text. This file matches the installed `typography` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/typography.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/typography.md`. ## Registry dependencies - `core` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/ui/markdown-heading`: `markdownHeadingAttributes` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/typography`: `headingClassName`, `Heading`, `Text`, types `TypeSize`, `TypeTone`, `TextWeight`, `HeadingLevel`, `HeadingProps`, `TextTag`, `TextProps` ## Composition ### Heading and Text Heading takes level (the document outline) and size (the rung); they are decoupled on purpose, so an h3 may wear heading-2. Text takes as, size, weight, and tone. className is for layout only: size, weight, face, and color come from props. ```tsx page section ``` ### Native tag A native tag may wear one text-* rung and nothing else from the scale: pair it with a tone or weight and it becomes Text or Heading. Heading rungs already carry font-display and text-balance. ```tsx one rung on the element

``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { Heading, Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography"; export function TypographyTokensExample() { return (

Display — page titles & heroes Heading 1 — content h1 One rung per size, named by role Level picks the tag, size defaults to the matching rung One class per heading: face, weight, and balance ride along An h3 wearing heading-2: level is the outline, size is the look Body large sets the emphasized reading size — intros, lead paragraphs, and anywhere copy needs a little more presence than the default. Body is the default for paragraphs, controls, and most of the interface. The five boxing wizards jump quickly, and the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Weight: normal, medium, semibold,{" "} bold for figures and overlays that must read at a glance. Label — form labels and small chrome. Caption — overlines, timestamps, and group labels. Micro — keycaps, badge counters, and dense metadata.
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `typography` - `heading` - `text` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/typography - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/typography.json
